description: Shared Rust <-> WASM vectors for command risk classification on the program that actually runs (issue #268). Expected values are derived by hand from the rule in crates/allw-core/src/command.rs (classify_effective_risk) and docs/policy-seam.md; bin is always argv[0] (unchanged by #268). Append-only.
